flags.why: “Mươi” does not mean frost; its meanings concern tens and approximately ten ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-m%C6%B0%C6%A1i)).
The common use meaning to sob, as in “khóc nấc lên,” is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-n%E1%BA%A5c)).
flags.fix: Add: verb | to sob; to gasp while crying.

flags.why: The common purpose use in expressions such as “cốt để giúp nhau” is not covered by the noun meanings ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-c%E1%BB%91t)).
flags.fix: Add: mainly to; with the main aim of — Tôi đến đây cốt để gặp anh. = I came here mainly to see you.

flags.why: In a match, the trailing team levels the score, so attributing that action jointly to both teams is misleading.
flags.fix: Đội khách san bằng tỉ số ở phút cuối. = The visiting team levelled the score in the last minute.
